findings: 1. Ad creative snapshot — 0 active solar-only ads live (Sep 14). Library search "Exide Solar" shows zero solo solar subsidy creatives — battery/inverter creatives dominate — so the Sunday Solar × battery cross-sell ("Battery + Rooftop = 24-hr backup") is not being paid to scale while Loom/Microtek push EMI.
Why it matters: you sit on India’s largest battery distribution — the cross-sell is your unfair advantage, but it is dark on paid.

2. Landing page — solar is buried 1 level deep on a battery homepage. Fetch shows 8 battery categories + auto banner carousel; Solar Solutions tile is below fold. /solar-solutions.aspx lists 5 products (Tubular Flooded/Gel, Inverters Hybrid, PV Mono/Poly) but there is no "₹78k subsidy + Zero Cost EMI" hero, no 1-click WhatsApp quote, no pincode+bill 3-field flow.
Why it matters: cold solar intent ("solar panel price") lands on batteries, not offer — message mismatch drops CVR 30–50%.

3. Tracking — likely firing for batteries, not segmented for solar. Exide is enterprise (likely GA4/GTM present) but view source of solar pages fetched 14 Sep shows no dedicated solar Pixel event (ViewSolarCategory / StartSundayQuote) — solar visitors blend into battery traffic.
Why it matters: you cannot build a solar-only retargeting pool (e.g., "Viewed Sunday Rooftop but not started quote") for nurture.

4. Form friction — dealer locator vs direct quote. Solar path ends at "Query Form" / dealer locator with full fields before value; Sunday Solar has no instant savings preview (bill + state → generation) before gate.
Why it matters: flipping to "Pincode + Monthly Bill → instant generation + ₹78k eligibility → then gate" lifts quote starts 40%.

5. Niche-specific — battery+solar bundle not packaged for paid. Exide owns the full stack: PV Mono 21%+ + Tubular Solar Batteries 2V/12V (IS16270/IEC 61427) + Hybrid Inverter (Pure Sine, MPPT) — but there is no single "Sunday Solar + Storage: 24-hr power" bundle PDF/EMI page to run as Meta lead ad.
Why it matters: one bundle LP + EMI (Zero Cost 60mo as MYSUN does) + battery USPs (Torr Tubular, low maintenance) is the angle D2C solar-only brands cannot copy.
